description:
WelcomeBanner hint says 'escape interrupt' implying Escape aborts in-progress generation. Actual behavior: `app.interrupt` is defined in keybindings.ex (mapped to Escape) but is NOT in @app_action_priority in interactive.ex, so it never matches. The Escape key falls through to handle_event_key which either exits (empty input) or clears the input.

When the AI is actively generating and input is empty, Escape exits the TUI entirely rather than calling OctoPi.Agent.abort/1.

Fix: add 'app.interrupt' to @app_action_priority and add a dispatch_app_action handler that aborts when a loader is active (similar to how app.clear handles Ctrl+C abort).
title: Escape exits TUI during active generation instead of aborting
